# Individual IP protection example

Demonstrates assigning a caller-owned Standard public IP directly to a DDoS protection plan using AzAPI.
The zone-redundant static IPv4 address uses regional Standard SKU, `ddosSettings.protectionMode = "Enabled"`, and the module's plan ID. It does not rely on VNet inheritance.
This is direct association with a DDoS protection plan, not standalone DDoS IP Protection without a plan, and it does not create a bring-your-own IP prefix.

**Manual deployment only:** direct public-IP plan association requires the subscription feature `Microsoft.Network/AllowBringYourOwnPublicIpAddress` and a refreshed `Microsoft.Network` provider registration.
Use an already-enabled subscription with administrator approval. The example does not register features; AVM CI cannot register this prerequisite.
The `.e2eignore` marker excludes this scenario from automated E2E discovery. Mocked tests still cover its request body, controls, outputs and Azure-response postcondition; skipping deployment is not runtime verification.

Resources default to `westus2`; region overrides must support public IP availability zones 1, 2 and 3.
The example checks Azure's returned protection mode and plan ID and exposes them through outputs.
To run manually, authenticate to an approved subscription, enter this directory, and run `terraform init`, `terraform plan`, `terraform apply`, a follow-up `terraform plan`, and `terraform destroy`. Review plans and verify cleanup.
Deployment incurs Azure DDoS protection plan and public IP charges.

```hcl
provider "azapi" {}

data "azapi_client_config" "this" {}

module "naming" {
  source  = "Azure/avm-utl-naming/azure"
  version = "0.2.0"
}

resource "azapi_resource" "resource_group" {
  location               = var.rg_location
  name                   = module.naming.resource_group.name_unique
  parent_id              = data.azapi_client_config.this.subscription_resource_id
  type                   = var.resource_types.resources_resource_groups
  ignore_body_changes    = length(var.ignore_body_changes.resources_resource_groups) > 0 ? var.ignore_body_changes.resources_resource_groups : null
  response_export_values = []
  retry                  = var.retry

  dynamic "timeouts" {
    for_each = var.timeouts == null ? [] : [var.timeouts]
    content {
      create = timeouts.value.create
      read   = timeouts.value.read
      update = timeouts.value.update
      delete = timeouts.value.delete
    }
  }
}

module "ddosprotectionplan" {
  source = "../../"

  location         = var.ddos_plan_location
  name             = module.naming.network_ddos_protection_plan.name_unique
  parent_id        = azapi_resource.resource_group.id
  enable_telemetry = var.enable_telemetry
}

resource "azapi_resource" "public_ip" {
  location  = var.ddos_plan_location
  name      = module.naming.public_ip.name_unique
  parent_id = azapi_resource.resource_group.id
  type      = var.resource_types.network_public_ip_addresses
  body = {
    zones = ["1", "2", "3"]
    sku = {
      name = "Standard"
      tier = "Regional"
    }
    properties = {
      publicIPAddressVersion   = "IPv4"
      publicIPAllocationMethod = "Static"
      ddosSettings = {
        protectionMode = "Enabled"
        ddosProtectionPlan = {
          id = module.ddosprotectionplan.resource_id
        }
      }
    }
  }
  ignore_body_changes    = length(var.ignore_body_changes.network_public_ip_addresses) > 0 ? var.ignore_body_changes.network_public_ip_addresses : null
  response_export_values = ["properties.ddosSettings"]
  retry                  = var.retry

  dynamic "timeouts" {
    for_each = var.timeouts == null ? [] : [var.timeouts]
    content {
      create = timeouts.value.create
      read   = timeouts.value.read
      update = timeouts.value.update
      delete = timeouts.value.delete
    }
  }

  lifecycle {
    postcondition {
      condition = try(
        self.output.properties.ddosSettings.protectionMode == "Enabled" &&
        lower(self.output.properties.ddosSettings.ddosProtectionPlan.id) == lower(module.ddosprotectionplan.resource_id),
        false
      )
      error_message = "The public IP must report Enabled DDoS protection with the example's DDoS protection plan ID."
    }
  }
}
```

## Optional Inputs

The following input variables are optional (have default values):

### <a name="input_ddos_plan_location"></a> [ddos\_plan\_location](#input\_ddos\_plan\_location)

Description: This variable defines the Azure region for the DDoS protection plan and public IP.  
The default value is "westus2". Choose a region supporting public IP availability zones 1, 2, and 3.

Type: `string`

Default: `"westus2"`

### <a name="input_enable_telemetry"></a> [enable\_telemetry](#input\_enable\_telemetry)

Description: This variable controls whether or not telemetry is enabled for the module.  
For more information see https://aka.ms/avm/telemetryinfo.  
If it is set to false, then no telemetry will be collected.

Type: `bool`

Default: `true`

### <a name="input_ignore_body_changes"></a> [ignore\_body\_changes](#input\_ignore\_body\_changes)

Description: Body-relative dot-notation paths ignored on `resources_resource_groups` and `network_public_ip_addresses`. Ignored configuration is not sent to Azure; changes take effect after apply.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    resources_resource_groups   = optional(list(string), [])
    network_public_ip_addresses = optional(list(string), [])
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_resource_types"></a> [resource\_types](#input\_resource\_types)

Description: AzAPI resource types and API versions: `resources_resource_groups` for the resource group and `network_public_ip_addresses` for the directly associated public IP.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    resources_resource_groups   = optional(string, "Microsoft.Resources/resourceGroups@2025-04-01")
    network_public_ip_addresses = optional(string, "Microsoft.Network/publicIPAddresses@2024-05-01")
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_retry"></a> [retry](#input\_retry)

Description: Retry controls for supporting AzAPI resources: error message patterns, initial interval in seconds, and maximum interval in seconds.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    error_message_regex  = optional(list(string))
    interval_seconds     = optional(number)
    max_interval_seconds = optional(number)
  })
```

Default: `null`

### <a name="input_rg_location"></a> [rg\_location](#input\_rg\_location)

Description: This variable defines the Azure region where the resource group will be created.  
The default value is "westus".

Type: `string`

Default: `"westus"`

### <a name="input_timeouts"></a> [timeouts](#input\_timeouts)

Description: Supporting resource operation timeouts: create, read, update, and delete, as Go duration strings.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    create = optional(string)
    read   = optional(string)
    update = optional(string)
    delete = optional(string)
  })
```

Default: `null`
